s: That's a good idea. Let's do it.|那是个好主意。我们做吧。
This is the most beautiful dress in the shop.|这是店里最漂亮的裙子。
It's the best one, but it's the most expensive.|它是最好的，但也是最贵的。
He is the tallest boy in his class.|他是班里最高的男孩。
This is the best film of the year.|这是今年最好的电影。
She has the most beautiful voice.|她有最动听的嗓音。
This is the most expensive model in the shop.|这是店里最贵的型号。
How do they compare? This one is cheaper.|它们相比如何？这个更便宜。
It's the cheapest, but it's also the smallest.|它最便宜，但也最小。
Which is more expensive, this one or that one?|这个和那个哪个更贵？
That one is more expensive than this one.|那个比这个贵。
But this one is the most practical.|但这个最实用。
Have you got any small change?|你有零钱吗？
I've got none. I've got some, but not much.|我没有。我有一些，但不多。
I've got some coins in my pocket.|我口袋里有几枚硬币。

t: I've got none. I've got some.
s: Have you got any brothers? I've got none.|你有兄弟吗？没有。
Have you got any sisters? I've got two.|你有姐妹吗？有两个。
Have you got any milk? I've got some.|你有牛奶吗？有一些。
Knock, knock! Who's there?|咚咚！谁呀？
Nobody's at home. Everybody is out.|没人在家。大家都出去了。
Somebody is knocking at the door.|有人在敲门。

zh: 每一个、没有、任何和一些
s: Everybody likes the new teacher.|大家都喜欢这位新老师。
There is nothing in the box.|盒子里什么都没有。
Is there anything in your bag? Yes, something.|你包里有东西吗？有一点。
What were you doing at eight this morning?|今天早上八点你在做什么？
I was having breakfast when the phone rang.|电话响时我正在吃早饭。
While I was eating, Tommy was playing.|我吃饭的时候，汤米在玩。
What were you doing when I called you?|我给你打电话时你在做什么？
I was watching TV.|我在看电视。
While she was cooking, he was reading.|她做饭的时候，他在看书。
It had already happened when I arrived.|我到的时候，事情已经发生了。
When I got to the station, the train had left.|我到车站时，火车已经开走了。
He had finished his homework before dinner.|晚饭前他已经做完了作业。

t: It had already happened when I...
s: When I arrived, they had already gone.|我到的时候，他们已经走了。
When I called, she had already left.|我打电话时，她已经走了。
When we got there, the film had already begun.|我们到那时，电影已经开始了。

g: 定语从句 who / which / that
s: The man in a hat is my uncle.|戴帽子的那个男人是我叔叔。
The book which I bought yesterday is very good.|我昨天买的那本书很好看。
The girl who is singing is my sister.|正在唱歌的女孩是我妹妹。
This is the house that Jack built.|这就是杰克盖的房子。
The man whom you met is my teacher.|你见到的那个人是我的老师。
The film which we saw was boring.|我们看的那部电影很无聊。
I'm going on a trip to Australia.|我要去澳大利亚旅行。
The city which I want to visit is Sydney.|我想去的城市是悉尼。
The friend who will meet me lives there.|要接我的朋友住在那里。
The pen that I lost was a present.|我丢的那支笔是件礼物。
The woman whom we saw is a doctor.|我们见到的那个女人是医生。
The bag which she bought is very expensive.|她买的那个包很贵。
I have to go now. It's late.|我得走了。太晚了。
Do you have to work tomorrow? Yes, I do.|你明天必须工作吗？是的。
She has to look after her mother.|她不得不照顾她妈妈。
I have to get up early every day.|我每天必须早起。
He has to wear a uniform at work.|他上班必须穿制服。
Do we have to wait here? Yes, you do.|我们必须在这里等吗？是的。

g: He can't be... He must be...
s: She can't be a teacher. She must be an actress.|她不可能是老师。她一定是演员。
He must be very rich. Look at his car.|他一定很有钱。看他的车。
That can't be true. It must be a mistake.|那不可能是真的。一定是弄错了。

t: He can't be... He must be...
s: He must be at least forty.|他至少有四十岁。
She can't be tired. She just got up.|她不可能累。她刚起床。
They must be at home now.|他们现在一定在家。
He was driving at seventy miles an hour.|他当时以每小时七十英里的速度行驶。
He must have been in a hurry.|他当时一定很赶时间。
He can't have been careful. That's the problem.|他当时不可能很小心。问题就在这儿。

t: He can't have been... He must have been...
s: He must have been very tired last night.|他昨晚一定很累。
She can't have been at home. I called twice.|她当时不可能在家。我打了两次电话。
They must have been surprised by the news.|他们一定被这个消息惊到了。

g: He may be... / I'm not sure
s: Don't be so sure! He may be right.|别那么肯定！他可能是对的。
I'm not sure, but he may have been ill.|我不确定，他可能是生病了。
She may be waiting for us outside.|她可能在外面等我们。

t: He may be... He may have been...
s: He may be a doctor, I'm not sure.|他可能是医生，我不确定。
She may have been late because of the rain.|她可能是因为下雨才迟到的。
They may not come today.|他们今天可能不来。
Have you heard the sensational news?|你听到那条轰动的新闻了吗？
He said that he had passed the exam.|他说他通过了考试。
He told me that he would leave tomorrow.|他告诉我他明天就走。
He said that he was very busy.|他说他很忙。
She told me that she had seen the film.|她告诉我她看过那部电影。
They said that they were leaving soon.|他们说他们很快就走。
Have you heard the latest report?|你听到最新报道了吗？
He said that the weather would be fine.|他说天气会很好。
He told me that the train had already left.|他告诉我火车已经开走了。
He said that he had lost his keys.|他说他丢了钥匙。
She told me that she was feeling better.|她告诉我她感觉好些了。
He said that he would call me later.|他说他稍后给我打电话。
If you have a dream, work for it.|如果你有梦想，就为它努力。
If it rains tomorrow, we'll stay at home.|如果明天下雨，我们就待在家里。
If I had more time, I would travel.|如果我有更多时间，我就去旅行。
If you are tired, go to bed early.|如果你累了，就早点睡。
If it is fine tomorrow, we will go out.|如果明天天气好，我们就出去。
If you don't hurry, you will be late.|如果你不快一点，就会迟到。
Is that you, John? Yes, it's me.|是你吗，约翰？是的，是我。
He wants to know if you are free tomorrow.|他想知道你们明天是否有空。
He wants to know when we will arrive.|他想知道我们什么时候到。

zh: 他想知道是否/为什么/什么/什么时候
s: He wants to know why you are late.|他想知道你为何迟到。
She wants to know what you are doing.|她想知道的你在做什么。
They want to know where you live.|他们想知道你住在哪里。

zh: 萨莉第一次乘火车旅行
s: Sally took her first train ride last week.|萨莉上周第一次坐火车。
Someone invited Sally to a party.|有人邀请萨莉参加聚会。
Sally was invited to a party by a friend.|萨莉被一位朋友邀请参加聚会。

t: Someone invited Sally to a party.
zh: 有人邀请萨莉参加聚会。
s: Someone cleaned the room yesterday.|昨天有人打扫了房间。
The room was cleaned yesterday.|房间昨天被打扫了。
Someone stole my bike last night.|昨晚有人偷了我的自行车。
We went for a walk through the woods.|我们穿过树林去散步。
He hasn't been served yet.|还没有人招待他。
He will be served soon.|很快就会有人招待他。
The letter hasn't been sent yet.|信还没有寄出。
The work will be finished tomorrow.|这项工作明天会完成。
The new school will be opened next month.|新学校下个月会启用。
